start: Member follows a plan Push 1, Pull 1, Legs 1; last workout was Push 1 yesterday

user_sees: Up next 'Pull 1' with '<n> exercises from your plan'
must_not: A different routine on Home, the Today page, the widget or the reminder

user_sees: Up next card 'Done: Pull 1' with 'Next: Legs 1'
must_not: Pull 1 still offered as next today

steps.action: Look at Home, the widget and the workout reminder
user_sees: The same sentence 'Done: Pull 1 · Next: Legs 1'

start: Member follows no plan; last workout came from Upper A in folder 'My split'

user_sees: 'Upper B' with '<n> exercises' and the folder it comes from
must_not: 'from your plan' for a folder not followed
The first folder's first routine instead of the one after the last done

user_sees: 'No plan yet' 'Pick a program or build one'
must_not: A routine that no longer exists

start: A followed folder whose routines have no exercises; or empty workouts logged

user_sees: 'Your plan has no exercises yet' 'Add exercises to a routine in <folder>'
must_not: A routine with 0 exercises offered to start

steps.action: Log an empty workout (no routine) and come back
must_not: The rotation moved on by an empty workout

user_sees: Up next counts from that folder's start day
must_not: Workouts from before the new plan's start moving its rotation
The old name on any screen

start: Home screen widget or lock-screen reminder

steps.action: Look at the widget or reminder with the phone locked
must_not: Weights, body weight or the gym's data on a lock screen
